applicabilityBasis.summary: Issuer terms prohibit describing PYUSDx as a GENIUS payment stablecoin, exclude U.S./EEA distribution and provide contractual PYUSD redemption only for eligible counterparties. That disclaimer does not settle statutory applicability.

genius.notes: Token-specific U.S. GENIUS authorization, legal issuer pathway and independent financial assurance were not established by the reviewed product, holder and reserve disclosures. Upstream PYUSD/USDC authorization is not local-token authorization. MiCA status is intentionally unassessed; geographic platform restrictions are not a regulatory out-of-scope ruling.

references.label: MoonPay PYUSDx holder and counterparty terms
